title: Track terminal-mode workers through Claude Code's Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501)
notes: From docs/research/claude-releases-2026-09-27-to-11-27.md. Claude Code 2.1.295 added OSC 7501, the Program Status Protocol: the terminal is told working, waiting or done without parsing output. Today a worker run with --terminal is tracked through hooks only. Do: confirm the sequence's format in Claude Code's docs first; then read it in the pty path (src/main/panes) as one more signal for the worker's state, in a decision module with a test, alongside the hooks (not replacing them unless the docs show it covers every state the hooks give). Docs: panes and workers READMEs.

comments.body: Format confirmed from the installed Claude Code 2.1.332 binary (no official doc page exists): Claude probes with ESC]7501;?BEL and only emits once the terminal answers with an OSC 7501 whose data starts with '?'. Status: ESC]7501;state=<working|blocked|done|idle|error>:app=claude-code[:id][:kind=permission|question|auth][:progress][:title,msg base64] BEL, plus state=clear. Paused-on-background-work reads 'working', so it does not give the Stop hook's waiting counts, prompt source or last message: it goes alongside the hooks. Plan: main answers the probe and reads the status in pane-shells.ts listenTo (new decision module src/main/panes/program-status.ts + test), feeding only what hooks miss (blocked on a question/auth/API error, and lifting that mark when working again) into session-requests notify, wired in main.ts. Overlap: #413 also edits src/main/panes/pane-shells.ts (the spawn catch, a different hunk) and docs/panes/history.md; #418 and #419 edit src/main/main.ts and docs/workers/README.md + history.md; #420 edits docs/workers/README.md + history.md.
